explain.en: At the start of the game the lances stand on the two edge squares.

explain.ja: 香車は前にどこまでも進めますが、後ろには下がれません。
explain.en: The lance moves any distance forward but cannot move backward.

section.ja: 香車の動き方、前にどこまでも
section.en: How the lance moves: any distance forward

explain.ja: 香車が成ると成香になり、金将と同じ動きになります。縦横1マスと斜め前に動けるようになり、進める方向が大きく変わります。持ち駒の香車を打つときは、下の方から打つほうが好手になることが多く、効いているマスが増えて働きがよくなります。前に長い射程を持つので「やり」とも呼ばれます。「香は下段から打て」という格言がありますが、局面によっては上の段から打つほうがよいこともあるので状況を見て決めます。初期配置の香車は1筋と9筋にあり、基本的には端から相手陣を突破するのに使いますが、相手の端にも香車がいるので簡単には突破できません。お互いの香車が端攻めを狙いつつ端を守る格好です。
explain.en: A promoted lance becomes a promoted lance piece moving like gold: one square orthogonally and diagonally forward, so its available directions change greatly. When dropping a lance from hand, dropping from lower down is often better, since more squares are covered and it works better. Its long forward reach also gets it the name "spear". A proverb says "drop the lance from the lower ranks", but in some positions a higher rank is better, so decide by the situation. Lances start on the 1st and 9th files and are basically used to break through the opponent's camp from the edge, but the opponent's lances also guard the edge, so it is not easy. Each side's lances aim at an edge attack while defending against the opponent's.

section.ja: 成香の動き方、成ると金の動きに
section.en: How the promoted lance moves: promoted, it moves like a gold

title.ja: 図2-1 香車が銀取りに当たっている
title.en: Figure 2-1: The lance attacks the silver

explain.ja: 使い方次第で強力な香車ですが、歩で攻められると弱いという弱点があります。たとえば図2-1では、このまま行けば銀を取れそうですが、相手は持ち駒の歩を使ったうまい指し手があります。
explain.en: The lance can be powerful, but it is weak to pawn attacks. In Figure 2-1, it seems the silver can be won, but the opponent has a good move using pawns in hand.

section.ja: 香車は歩に弱い?連打の歩で香車を取る
section.en: Is the lance weak to pawns? Capture the lance with a succession of pawns

title.ja: 図2-2 連打の歩で香車が取られる
title.en: Figure 2-2: The lance gets captured by a series of pawns

explain.ja: 香車は後ろに下がれないため、歩を連打して攻められると簡単に取られます。香車にとって歩は天敵で、歩を何枚も連続で打つ手筋を「連打の歩」と言います。
explain.en: A lance cannot retreat, so it is easily captured by a barrage of pawns. The pawn is the lance's natural enemy, and dropping several pawns in a row is the "renda no fu" (pawn barrage) tesuji.

section.ja: 香車は歩に弱い?連打の歩で香車を取る
section.en: Is the lance weak to pawns? Capture the lance with a succession of pawns

title.ja: 図2-3 持ち駒の香車を使いたい
title.en: Figure 2-3: You want to use the lance in hand

explain.ja: 歩に弱い香車ですが、相手が歩を使えない状況では無類の強さを発揮します。たとえば図2-3で、持ち駒の香車をうまく使って駒得する手順を考えます。
explain.en: A lance is weak to pawns, but it shows unmatched strength when the opponent cannot use pawns. In Figure 2-3, for example, find a way to use the lance in hand to win material.

section.ja: 歩が居ないときは無類の強さに!?歩の裏側に香車を打つ
section.en: Incredibly strong when the opponent has no pawn! Drop a lance behind the pawn

title.ja: 図2-4 歩の裏側に香を打つ
title.en: Figure 2-4: Drop the lance behind the pawn

explain.ja: ▲5五歩、△同歩、▲5四香とすれば、相手の金か銀のどちらかが取れます。相手の歩の裏側に香車を打てば、歩で弾かれることがありません。後手は△5三歩と打ちたくても二歩になるので打てません。相手が歩を打てない状況を作ると香車の威力は倍増し、ほかにも相手に持ち歩がないときが香車を打つチャンスです。
explain.en: With ▲5五歩, △同歩, ▲5四香, either the gold or the silver can be captured. Dropping the lance behind the opponent's pawn means it cannot be knocked away by a pawn. White would like to drop △5三歩 but that would be nifu. Making a situation in which the opponent cannot drop a pawn doubles the lance's power, and a time when the opponent has no pawn in hand is also a chance to drop the lance.

section.ja: 歩が居ないときは無類の強さに!?歩の裏側に香車を打つ
section.en: Incredibly strong when the opponent has no pawn! Drop a lance behind the pawn

title.ja: 図3-1 香車の田楽刺し

explain.ja: 図3-1のような香車による両取りの手筋を「田楽刺し」と言います。角が前に進めないのがポイントで、香車を取り返せません。相手が何もしなければ角が取れ、角が逃げれば飛車が取れます。角のように前に進めない駒を狙って香車を打つのがポイントです。
explain.en: A lance fork like Figure 3-1 is called dengaku-zashi (skewer). The point is that the bishop cannot move forward, so the lance cannot be recaptured. If the opponent does nothing the bishop is taken; if the bishop flees the rook is taken. The key is to drop the lance aiming at a piece that cannot move forward, such as a bishop.

title.ja: 図3-2 香車をどこに打つ？
title.en: Figure 3-2: Where to drop the lance?

explain.ja: 図3-2のような局面を考えます。持ち駒の香車をどこに打つのがよいでしょうか。飛車での攻めをうまく支援できる手順を考えます。
explain.en: Consider the position in Figure 3-2. Where is the best place to drop the lance in hand? Think of a way to support the rook's attack well.

title.ja: 図3-3 香車と飛車の2段ロケット
title.en: Figure 3-3: Two-stage rocket of lance and rook

explain.ja: ここでは▲2七香と打つのが正解で、次の▲2三香成が厳しい攻めになります。このように飛車や香車といった前に進む駒を重ねて打つ手筋を「2段ロケット」と呼びます。単純ですが破壊力があり、これを使って端を攻める戦法が「雀刺し」です。
explain.en: ▲2七香 is the correct drop here, and the next ▲2三香成 is a severe attack. Stacking forward-moving pieces such as rook and lance like this is called the "two-stage rocket". It is simple but destructive, and the strategy that uses it to attack the edge is Suzume-zashi (Sparrow Skewer).

title.ja: 図3-4 香車をどこに打つ？
title.en: Figure 3-4: Where to drop the lance?

explain.ja: 今度は図3-4のような局面を考えます。持ち駒の香車をどこに打てばよいでしょうか。また▲2七香と打ちたくなりますが。
explain.en: Now consider the position in Figure 3-4. Where should the lance in hand be dropped? ▲2七香 is tempting again.

title.ja: 図3-5 今度は飛車の裏に香車を打つ
title.en: Figure 3-5: This time drop the lance behind the rook

explain.ja: この場合は、▲2九香と飛車の後ろに香車を打つのがよい手です。次の▲2一飛成で相手玉は詰みます。香車を飛車の前に打つべきか後ろに打つべきかは状況で変わるので、臨機応変に対応します。
explain.en: In this case dropping the lance behind the rook with ▲2九香 is the good move. The next ▲2一飛成 mates the king. Whether to drop the lance in front of or behind the rook depends on the situation, so adapt.

title.ja: 図3-6 相手からの攻めをどう受ける？
title.en: Figure 3-6: How to defend against the opponent's attack?

explain.ja: 図3-6の局面を考えます。相手の2枚飛車による攻めをどう受ければよいでしょうか。
explain.en: Consider the position in Figure 3-6. How should the opponent's attack with two rooks be answered?

title.en: Figure 3-7: Defending with a bottom lance

explain.ja: この場合は▲4九香と打てば受かります。このように金の底に香車を打つと囲いが非常に堅くなり、この手筋を「底香」と呼びます。
explain.en: In this case dropping ▲4九香 defends. Dropping a lance beneath the gold makes the castle very solid, and this tesuji is called "soko-kyo" (bottom lance).

title.ja: 図a-1 底歩だとなおよし
title.en: Figure a-1: A bottom pawn is even better

explain.ja: 底香の代わりに歩を打つ手筋は「底歩」です。図3-6では二歩になるので底歩は打てませんが、底歩で受けられるときは、香車より安い歩で受けるほうがよい場合が多いです。
explain.en: Dropping a pawn instead of a lance is the soko-fu tesuji. In Figure 3-6 it would be nifu so the bottom pawn cannot be dropped, but when a bottom pawn can defend, the cheaper pawn is often better than a lance.
